palettes.name: Rhine Slate
palettes.story: Cool slate neutrals, a deep cobalt doing all the work, a signal-orange spark for one moment per page.

palettes.name: Matcha Paper
palettes.story: Green-tinted paper, whisked-matcha green, a plum note for warmth.

palettes.name: Bauhaus Primaries
palettes.story: Red, blue, yellow on off-white — use as flat blocks, circles and squares, never as gradients.

palettes.name: Swiss Signal
palettes.story: Pure white, true black type, one signal red. Nothing else.

palettes.name: Hanko

palettes.name: Solarpunk

palettes.name: Quiet Capital
palettes.story: Stone-grey ground, charcoal type, a bronze accent. Wealth that whispers.

palettes.name: Oxblood Library

palettes.name: Glacier Lab

palettes.name: Nordic Birch
